I diagnosed the issue against the real repo (`coding-hermes/code-factory`) and verified the fix empirically. Solution written to `~/solution.md`.

## What's actually wrong

The single gate-moving failure is **not in the CF-239/CF-416 residue** — it's an inherited red on the canonical baseline:

- `tests/selftest.sh` §61 (`cf050_publish_gate`) penalizes any absolute `/home/<user>/` path in the published tree with a zero baseline.
- `origin/main` @ `b26d2ecc` already tracks `docs/audits/code-factory-perf-2026-11-11-PERF-017.md`, which contains `~/code-factory` on lines 11 and 152 → `FAIL publish paths — baseline 0, current 1`.

The `  FAIL  ` rows that make the count non-obvious are intentional diagnostics emitted by child processes / `printf` (CF-071's 19 arms + red control, board/parser fixtures, tailnet red proof, `docs/fixture.md`); only rows that do `fails=$((fails+1))` count.

## Reliable attribution method

Differential failure-set: run the same full suite in a pristine worktree at `b26d2ecc` and in the candidate on the same host; normalize and subtract the `^  FAIL  ` streams. Fixture rows and pre-existing controls cancel; the delta is the gate-mover. I verified this:

- base `SELFTEST: FAIL (2)`, fixed tree `SELFTEST: FAIL (1)`
- delta = exactly `FAIL  publish paths — ... PERF-017.md`
- isolated §61: base `FAIL (1)` → after fix `PASS`

(The second base failure here is env-only: this sandbox has `go1.26.8`, repo pins `go1.26.5`. On the original host that arm passes, matching `FAIL (1)`.)

## Exact fix (CF-050 residual)

Redact the two host-path literals in `docs/audits/code-factory-perf-2026-11-11-PERF-017.md` (replace the clone path with `CF=${CF:-/path/to/code-factory}` and describe the checkout generically), then `git add` it so the guard grades the index — the same state the rescue guard used.

**Conclusion:** the residue is safe to preserve/close; the baseline, not the change, is red.
